01 / THE WORKSHOP

Where AI meets
its infrastructure.

GeniSys explores synergy among next-generation AI, systems, and networking for a sustainable future.

Join researchers across algorithms, systems software, and networked platforms to discuss scalable, reliable, secure, and energy-efficient AI.

01

Efficient AI

Scalable training, distributed inference, and optimization across models, compilers, and heterogeneous accelerators.

MODELS + COMPUTE
02

Connected systems

Communication-efficient learning, networked platforms, and resilient infrastructure for distributed AI workloads.

SYSTEMS + NETWORKS
03

Sustainable computing

Energy-aware design, secure deployment, and responsible use of computing resources at every layer.

EFFICIENCY + RELIABILITY

Invited talks · Research posters & demos · Panels · Student lightning talks

Common questions

Can I present work that is already published?

Yes. Previously published work is welcome, alongside recent research. Use the session to share your findings with the GeniSys community and discuss new directions.

What should I prepare?

Start with a clear research question, your approach, and the results or insights you would like to discuss. Submit your research poster using the Box form below. File requirements and poster dimensions will be announced.

Can I present a poster remotely?

Hybrid workshop participation is planned. Arrangements for remote poster presentations have not yet been announced.
